name: Trading Post Pier
notes: The opening fishing platform behind the Dry Dock area. The five-Snapper contract is completed here with the Simple Rod and Earthworm.

name: Peaceful Fishing Grounds
notes: The marked peaceful spot where the three-Softgrazer contract is completed. Equip Wind-Up Tin, cast into the active zone and let the fish take the bait before pulling.

name: Predator Splash Zone
notes: Predators reveal themselves through splash zones on the surface. Cast Rainbow Fin into the disturbance and retrieve steadily; three Harpooners unlock the Carburetor purchase.

name: Sheltered Shallows
notes: Low-level peaceful water close to the settlement. Wind-Up Tin covers the resident species.

name: Trading Post Channels
notes: The channels threading the settlement, home to early predators. Bully requires the narrow Pipecross / Deadly Tick bait pair.

name: Blighted Backwater
notes: Sea Blight-corrupted water where mutant fish appear. Expect only a couple of habitats per mutant species.

name: Drowned Ruins
notes: Flooded buildings and rubble. Peaceful mutants such as Gravedigger are recorded here.

name: Wreck Fields
notes: Dense shipwreck water. Rammfish hunts here and only takes Pipecross / Deadly Tick.

name: Night Water
notes: Species tied to the night cycle across the open water. Bring a Spotlight if the boat has one.

name: Deep Channels
notes: Level 10–30 predator water beyond the settlement reach. Check fuel and hull before the run.
